newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,242 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,242 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 2,242 contracts compared with 1,251 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 77 wheat, 726 corn, 1,232 soybean, 143 soymeal, 62 soyoil, two oat, six soybean calls, 54 soybean puts, one corn put and one soymeal call traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 to 2-1/4 cent per bushel higher, corn was one to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were two cents higher to 3/4 cents lower.
